items.question: What arises when the hidden true nature is known?
premises: Knowing the hidden true nature precedes arising.
The verse links knowledge to arising.
items.inference: All-knowingness arises from knowing the hidden true nature.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ is not specified in this verse.
Whether gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ is appositional or adjectival is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
